lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular blobs arranged in approximately vertical columns across the visible lateral flank, appearing in a semi-regular grid posterior to the dorsal fin region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating a lattice-like visual structure on the posterior flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge running from the posterior base of the first dorsal fin toward the caudal region, showing a sharp luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal edge and deep shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A dense distribution of small, high-luminance circular clusters bounded within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, with higher density than the adjacent lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Two remoras are attached to the dorsal surface of the shark, located immediately posterior to the first dorsal fin.
